title: Stablecoins Explained: Digital Dollars on the Blockchain
imageAlt: Digital dollar tokens moving across a blockchain network
summary: A digital token designed to hold a steady value, usually pegged 1:1 to the US dollar. How reserves work, why stablecoins matter, the GENIUS Act and the risks.

title: What is real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, in plain words?
imageAlt: Real estate, gold and bonds flowing into a blockchain network and coming out as digital tokenized assets
summary: Taking ownership of something real, like a bond, a property, gold or an invoice, and recording it as a digital token on a blockchain. Why it matters, and the challenges.
